spans.s:
m. (-तुः)
1 Measure in general.
2 Cleaning, purifying.
3 A cleanser, a purifier.
E.
यु to mix, or not to mix, and तुन् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-त्रं)
The tie that fastens the yoke of a plough to the neck of the ox.
E.
यु to join, ष्ट्रन् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
About to fight, ready to fight.
E.
युध to fight, desid. v., future tense, शतृ aff.
